The Court made the following ORDER:
This Criminal Petition, under Section 482 of Bharatiya Nagarik Suraksha Sanhita,
2023, has been filed by the petitioners/A3 to A5 and A8, seeking anticipatory bail, in connection with Crime No.306 of 2018 of Anantapuramu I Town Police Station,
Anantapuramu district.
2. A case has been registered against the petitioners herein and others for the offences punishable under Sections 420 and 409 read with 34 IPC.
3. Case of the prosecution, in brief, is that the agencies mentioned in the complaint are manpower supply agencies, its services have been renewed by the Government and both entered into an agreement also and according to the said agreement the honorarium pertaining to the non-teaching Rushi Venkateshwara vs The State Of Andhra Pradesh on 10 January, 2025 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/10306949/

sentences.text: staff of KGBVs was released for the period from June, 2015 to 2017 to the outsourcing agencies, in turn the said agencies have to transfer the same to the accounts of the individuals, but the said agencies released the honorarium by deducting EPF, ESI and agency commission of 1% which is approximately of Rs.82,28,218/-, thus the agencies misappropriated the funds and violated the terms and conditions.

5. Learned counsel appearing on behalf of the petitioners submits that the petitioners deducted the amounts for paying to the ESI and EPF and in view of the said reason the amount could not be credited to the account of the employees.
6. The accusation against the petitioners herein is that they have to transfer the honorarium to the accounts of the outsourcing employees, but they released the honorarium by deducting EPF, ESI etc.
The acts of the accused are part of discharge of their official duties.
More so, the crime is of the year 2018 and till date the police have not taken any action.
7. In view of the aforesaid facts and circumstances of the case, this Court is inclined to grant anticipatory bail to the petitioners herein/A3 to A5 and A8 on the following conditions.

i) In the event of arrest of the petitioners herein/A3 to A5 and A8 in the aforesaid crime, they shall be enlarged on bail on their executing personal bonds for a sum of Rs.10,000/-
(Rupees Ten Thousand only) each with two sureties of the like sum each to the satisfaction of the concerned Arresting Officer.

ii) Petitioners shall make themselves available for interrogation by a police officer as and when required, and they shall not, directly or indirectly, make any inducement, threat or promise to any person acquainted with the facts of the case so as to dissuade him from disclosing such facts to the Court or to any police officer.
iii) Petitioners shall appear before the Station House Officer concerned, once in a week i.e., on every Saturday between 10.00 am and 01.00 pm, till filing of the charge sheet.
8.
Accordingly, the Criminal Petition is allowed.
As a sequel thereto, the miscellaneous petitions, if any, pending in this Criminal Petition shall stand closed.
